docs: The admin pubkey

fields.name: disableFlags
docs: Flags to disable certain functionality
bit 0 - Disable create pool
bit 1 - Disable deposit
bit 2 - Disable withdraw
bit 3 - Disable buy
bit 4 - Disable sell

docs: Addresses of the protocol fee recipients

fields.name: adminSetCoinCreatorAuthority
docs: The admin authority for setting coin creators

fields.name: lpSupply
docs: True circulating supply without burns and lock-ups

fields.name: virtualQuoteReserves
docs: For non-boost pools, value is 0, so the behavior is identical to legacy pools.

fields.name: mintAuthority
docs: Optional authority used to mint new tokens. The mint authority may only
be provided during mint creation. If no mint authority is present
then the mint has a fixed supply and no further tokens may be minted.

fields.name: supply
docs: Total supply of tokens.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Number of base 10 digits to the right of the decimal place.

fields.name: isInitialized
docs: Is `true` if this structure has been initialized.

fields.name: freezeAuthority
docs: Optional authority to freeze token accounts.

display.interpolatedIntent: Sets the coin creator of pool ${accounts.pool} to ${data.coinCreator}
${accounts.admin} updates the token incentives PumpSwap pays in ${accounts.mint}

display.intent: Buy and burn with a boost
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.authority} spends ${data.quoteAmountIn} of ${accounts.quoteMint} from the boost vault of pool ${accounts.pool} to buy at least ${data.minBaseAmountBurned} of ${accounts.baseMint} from the pool and burn it

instructions.name: buy
docs: For cashback coins, optionally pass user_volume_accumulator_wsol_ata as remaining_accounts[0].
If provided and valid, the ATA will be initialized if needed.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.user} buys ${data.baseAmountOut} of ${accounts.baseMint} for at most ${data.maxQuoteAmountIn} of ${accounts.quoteMint} from pool ${accounts.pool}

docs: The accounts the program reads after the named ones, in order:
for a cashback coin, the quote token account of the buyer's volume accumulator;
for a coin that graduated from Pump's bonding curve, the pool-v2 account (seeds `pool-v2`, base mint);
then one of the buyback fee recipients of the global config, and its quote token account.

instructions.name: buyExactQuoteIn
docs: Given a budget of spendable_quote_in, buy at least min_base_amount_out
Fees will be deducted from spendable_quote_in
f(quote) = tokens, where tokens >= min_base_amount_out
Make sure the payer has enough SOL to cover creation of the following accounts (unless already created):
- protocol_fee_recipient_token_account: rent.minimum_balance(TokenAccount::LEN)
- coin_creator_vault_ata: rent.minimum_balance(TokenAccount::LEN)
- user_volume_accumulator: rent.minimum_balance(UserVolumeAccumulator::LEN)
For cashback coins, optionally pass user_volume_accumulator_wsol_ata as remaining_accounts[0].
If provided and valid, the ATA will be initialized if needed.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.user} spends up to ${data.spendableQuoteIn} of ${accounts.quoteMint} to buy at least ${data.minBaseAmountOut} of ${accounts.baseMint} from pool ${accounts.pool}

docs: The accounts the program reads after the named ones, in order:
for a cashback coin, the quote token account of the buyer's volume accumulator;
for a coin that graduated from Pump's bonding curve, the pool-v2 account (seeds `pool-v2`, base mint);
then one of the buyback fee recipients of the global config, and its quote token account.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.user} spends up to ${data.spendableQuoteIn} of ${accounts.quoteMint} to buy at least ${data.minBaseAmountOut} of ${accounts.baseMint} from pool ${accounts.pool}
${accounts.user} buys ${data.baseAmountOut} of ${accounts.baseMint} for at most ${data.maxQuoteAmountIn} of ${accounts.quoteMint} from pool ${accounts.pool}

instructions.name: claimCashback
docs: Pays out the user's accrued cashback. `user_wsol_token_account` may be any token account
of `quote_mint` owned by `user`, not only the associated one.

display.interpolatedIntent: Pays the cashback ${accounts.user} has earned to ${accounts.userWsolTokenAccount}
${accounts.payer} claims the token incentives of ${accounts.user} in ${accounts.mint} into ${accounts.userAta}
${accounts.user} closes their volume accumulator ${accounts.userVolumeAccumulator}
Collects the creator fees of ${accounts.coinCreator} in ${accounts.quoteMint} into ${accounts.coinCreatorTokenAccount}

${accounts.admin} creates PumpSwap's global config with an LP fee of ${data.lpFeeBasisPoints}, a protocol fee of ${data.protocolFeeBasisPoints} and a coin creator fee of ${data.coinCreatorFeeBasisPoints}
${accounts.creator} creates pool ${accounts.pool}, depositing ${data.baseAmountIn} of ${accounts.baseMint} and ${data.quoteAmountIn} of ${accounts.quoteMint}

${accounts.user} deposits at most ${data.maxBaseAmountIn} of ${accounts.baseMint} and ${data.maxQuoteAmountIn} of ${accounts.quoteMint} into pool ${accounts.pool} for ${data.lpTokenAmountOut} LP tokens
${accounts.admin} sets which PumpSwap operations are disabled
${accounts.user} extends the data of the PumpSwap account ${accounts.account}
${accounts.creator} sets up the boost vault ${accounts.boostVault} of pool ${accounts.pool}
${accounts.payer} creates the volume accumulator ${accounts.userVolumeAccumulator} of ${accounts.user}

instructions.name: migratePoolCoinCreator
docs: Migrate Pool Coin Creator to Sharing Config

display.interpolatedIntent: Migrates the coin creator of pool ${accounts.pool} to the sharing config ${accounts.sharingConfig}

${accounts.user} swaps ${data.amountIn} of the token of ${accounts.userInTokenAccount} for at least ${data.minAmountOut} of the token of ${accounts.userOutTokenAccount}, through a route of PumpSwap pools and Pump bonding curves

docs: One group of five accounts per hop, in route order. Pool hop: the pool's base mint, quote mint,
the pool, its base vault and its quote vault. Bonding curve hop: the coin's mint, its quote mint,
the bonding curve, its base token account and its quote token account.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.user} sells ${data.baseAmountIn} of ${accounts.baseMint} for at least ${data.minQuoteAmountOut} of ${accounts.quoteMint} to pool ${accounts.pool}

docs: The accounts the program reads after the named ones, in order:
for a cashback coin, the quote token account of the seller's volume accumulator, then the volume accumulator;
for a coin that graduated from Pump's bonding curve, the pool-v2 account (seeds `pool-v2`, base mint);
then one of the buyback fee recipients of the global config, and its quote token account.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.user} sells ${data.baseAmountIn} of ${accounts.baseMint} for at least ${data.minQuoteAmountOut} of ${accounts.quoteMint} to pool ${accounts.pool}
${accounts.admin} makes ${accounts.boostAuthority} the boost authority of PumpSwap

instructions.name: setCoinCreator
docs: Sets Pool::coin_creator from Metaplex metadata creator or BondingCurve::creator

display.interpolatedIntent: Sets the coin creator of pool ${accounts.pool} from its token's metadata or bonding curve

instructions.name: transferCreatorFeesToPump
docs: Transfer creator fees to pump creator vault
If coin creator fees are currently below rent.minimum_balance(TokenAccount::LEN)
The transfer will be skipped

accounts.name: wsolMint
docs: Pump Canonical Pool are quoted in wSOL

display.interpolatedIntent: Moves the PumpSwap creator fees of ${accounts.coinCreator} to their Pump creator vault ${accounts.pumpCreatorVault}
${accounts.payer} moves the PumpSwap creator fees of ${accounts.coinCreator} in ${accounts.quoteMint} to their Pump creator vault ${accounts.pumpCreatorVault}
${accounts.admin} makes ${accounts.newAdmin} the admin of PumpSwap
${accounts.admin} updates PumpSwap's buyback config
${accounts.admin} sets whether pools can carry their own creator fee to ${data.creatorFeeConfigurable}, up to ${data.maxConfigurableCreatorFeeBps}
${accounts.admin} sets PumpSwap's LP fee to ${data.lpFeeBasisPoints}, its protocol fee to ${data.protocolFeeBasisPoints} and its coin creator fee to ${data.coinCreatorFeeBasisPoints}
${accounts.user} burns ${data.lpTokenAmountIn} LP tokens of pool ${accounts.pool} for at least ${data.minBaseAmountOut} of ${accounts.baseMint} and ${data.minQuoteAmountOut} of ${accounts.quoteMint}
